question.prompt: What fraction lies halfway between \(\dfrac15\) and \(\dfrac13\) on the number line?

solutions.explanation:
Writing both endpoints with the same denominator makes their spacing easy to compare:
\[
\frac15=\frac3{15},\qquad \frac13=\frac5{15}.
\]
The fraction \(\frac4{15}\) lies between them and is the same distance from each, because
\[
\frac4{15}-\frac3{15}=\frac1{15},\qquad
\frac5{15}-\frac4{15}=\frac1{15}.
\]
Therefore the halfway fraction is \(\frac4{15}\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Use equal fractional units
